name: npbk
description: Full stack application with NBK backend and NFR frontend

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd nbk && npm install && cd ../nfr && npm install
scripts.build: npm install && concurrently "npm run build:backend" "npm run build:frontend" && npm run copy-frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd nbk && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd nfr && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd nbk && npm run dev" "cd nfr && npm start"
